translations.web: and repays those who hate him to their face, to destroy them. He will not be slack to him who hates him. He will repay him to his face.
translations.bsb: But those who hate Him He repays to their faces with destruction; He will not hesitate to repay to his face the one who hates Him.
translations.kjv: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
